HEXAGHOST-BOLSTERING_GHOSTFLAME.title: Fiamma Spettrale Rinforzante
HEXAGHOST-BOLSTERING_GHOSTFLAME.descript:
[gold]Ignites[/gold] by playing [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potere[/gold] while on esso. 
You gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Blocco[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Forza[/gold].
HEXAGHOST-CRUSHING_GHOSTFLAME.title: Fiamma Spettrale Schiacciante
HEXAGHOST-CRUSHING_GHOSTFLAME.descriptio:
[gold]Ignites[/gold] by playing [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Abilità[/gold] while on esso. 
Deals [blue]3[/blue] damage a un nemico casuale twice.
HEXAGHOST-INFERNO_GHOSTFLAME.title: Fiamma Spettrale Inferno
HEXAGHOST-INFERNO_GHOSTFLAME.description:
[gold]Ignites[/gold] by spending [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Energia[/gold] while on esso.
Deals [blue]4[/blue] damage a un nemico casuale per ogni Fiamma Spettrale [gold]Accesa[/gold].
If all Ghostflames are [gold]Accesa[/gold], gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Intensità[/gold].
[gold]Estingui[/gold] other Ghostflames.
Alla fine del tuo turno, [gold]Extinguishes[/gold] itself.
HEXAGHOST-SEARING_GHOSTFLAME.title: Fiamma Spettrale Ustionante
HEXAGHOST-SEARING_GHOSTFLAME.description:
[gold]Ignites[/gold] by playing [blue]2[/blue] Attacks while on esso.
Applies [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Brucianima[/gold] a un nemico casuale twice.
